scripts.test: npx cross-env NODE_ENV=staging npx playwright test
scripts.test:frontend: npx cross-env NODE_ENV=staging npx playwright test tests/playwright/frontend
scripts.test:backend: npx cross-env NODE_ENV=staging npx playwright test tests/playwright/backend
scripts.dev:staging: npx cross-env NODE_ENV=staging concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.dev:prod: npx cross-env NODE_ENV=production concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
